user.title: Set up UI Entity Mapper
user.description: UI Entity Mapper lets you create rule-based mappings between Home Assistant entities. No YAML required — everything is configured through the UI.

abort.already_configured: UI Entity Mapper is already set up. Use the configure button to manage mappings.

add_mapping.title: Add Mapping — Basic Settings
add_mapping.description: Select the source and target entities. The available mapping modes are determined automatically from the entity domains.

data.name: Mapping name
data.retry_delay_seconds: Retry delay in seconds (0 = no retry)

data_description.retry_delay_seconds: If the target does not reach the desired state, retry after this many seconds.
data_description.max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts. 0 disables retries even if a delay is set.

add_mapping_mode.title: Add Mapping — Mode & Transform
add_mapping_mode.description: Source domain: **{source_domain}** → Target domain: **{target_domain}**. Only compatible modes are shown.

manage_mappings.title: Manage Mappings
manage_mappings.description: Select a mapping to edit, delete, toggle, or duplicate.

edit_mapping.title: Edit Mapping — Basic Settings
edit_mapping.description: Modify the source and target entities, direction, and retry settings.

data.name: Mapping name
data.retry_delay_seconds: Retry delay in seconds (0 = no retry)

delete_mapping.title: Delete Mapping
delete_mapping.description: Are you sure you want to permanently delete the mapping **{name}**? This action cannot be undone.

error.no_valid_modes: No compatible mapping modes exist for the selected source / target combination. Please choose a different pair of entities.
error.invalid_source_for_mode: The source entity domain is not compatible with the selected mode.
error.invalid_target_for_mode: The target entity domain is not compatible with the selected mode.
error.no_mappings: No mappings have been configured yet. Use 'Add mapping' first.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload the UI Entity Mapper integration, re-reading all mapping configurations.

enable_mapping.name: Enable Mapping
enable_mapping.description: Enable a mapping by its unique ID.

mapping_id.name: Mapping ID
mapping_id.description: The UUID of the mapping to enable.

disable_mapping.name: Disable Mapping
disable_mapping.description: Disable a mapping by its unique ID. Pending retries are cancelled.

mapping_id.name: Mapping ID
mapping_id.description: The UUID of the mapping to disable.

run_mapping_once.name: Run Mapping Once
run_mapping_once.description: Manually trigger a mapping once using the current source entity state.

mapping_id.name: Mapping ID
mapping_id.description: The UUID of the mapping to run.

export_mappings.name: Export Mappings
export_mappings.description: Return all mapping configurations as a JSON-serialisable service response.

import_mappings.name: Import Mappings
import_mappings.description: Import one or more mapping configurations from a list. Existing mappings are preserved.

mappings.name: Mappings
mappings.description: List of mapping configuration objects to import.
